MikroTik CRS310-1G-5S-4S+IN – High-Performance Compact Cloud Router Switch

Ultra-Fast 10G Fiber Networking in a Compact Form

The MikroTik CRS310-1G-5S-4S+IN is a powerful and compact Cloud Router Switch, designed for high-speed networking in enterprise, ISP, and home lab environments. Equipped with five SFP ports and four 10G SFP+ ports, this switch is perfect for fiber connectivity while ensuring low latency and high efficiency.


With dual boot support for RouterOS L5 and SwitchOS, users can configure it for advanced routing or optimized switching performance based on their specific needs.


Key Features

  • Blazing-Fast 10G Connectivity – 4 x 10G SFP+ cages for ultra-fast networking.
  • Flexible Fiber Expansion – 5 x SFP cages for high-speed fiber links.
  • Reliable Gigabit Backup – 1 x Gigabit LAN port for additional connectivity.
  • Dual Boot System – Choose between RouterOS L5 or SwitchOS for maximum flexibility.
  • Compact & Silent – Fanless passive cooling design for noise-free operation.
  • Powerful Performance – 800MHz CPU & 256MB RAM for efficient traffic handling.
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Low power consumption with passive cooling.
  • Durable & Rackmount Ready – Includes rackmount ears for easy installation.
  • MikroTik Reliability – Manufactured in Latvia, ensuring top-tier quality.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Guaranteed performance and long-term support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CRS310-1G-5S-4S+IN
  • CPU: 800 MHz
  • RAM: 256MB
  • SFP Ports: 5 x 1G SFP cages
  • SFP+ Ports: 4 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Ethernet Ports: 1 x Gigabit LAN
  • Operating System: RouterOS L5 / SwitchOS (dual boot)
  • Switching Capacity: 80 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 119 Mpps
  • Cooling: Fanless passive cooling
  • Form Factor: Compact passive desktop case, rackmount ears included
  • Power Supply: External PSU included
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia (Made in China, Vietnam)
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise & Data Centers – Fast and reliable fiber backbone with low latency.
  • ISPs & Service Providers – Seamless fiber network expansion with 10G support.
  • Home Labs & Network Enthusiasts – Perfect for advanced networking setups.
  • Silent Office Environments – Passive cooling ensures completely noise-free operation.


Why Choose MikroTik CRS310-1G-5S-4S+IN?

  • Affordable High-Speed Fiber Switching – Cost-effective 10G SFP+ switch for professionals.
  • Compact & Versatile – Ideal for space-constrained environments with rackmount options.
  • Reliable & Scalable – Built with MikroTik’s advanced networking technology.
  • Energy-Efficient & Silent – Passive cooling eliminates noise and reduces power consumption.
